iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: valve's e-ink screen schematics released for home tinkerers
a drifting space telescope waiting for a rescue tug
postgres guarding memory that must never overcommit
snow shoveling that somehow earned the keys to the kingdom
san francisco summer holding cool under soft cloud

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Stutter-house pulse game: tap the silent gaps between chopped beats as a club track builds; each clean hit adds a layer, each miss glitches the waveform.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one 45-second drop that climaxes when you nail the final stutter break
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM stutters widen, double-taps and ghost beats appear mid-round
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe dancefloor with waveform ripples

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick tiny rescue probes at a tumbling space telescope before it slips below the horizon; each tethered hit buys seconds and stabilizes spin.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one perfect save feels like catching a falling star in a single gesture
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: telescope spin rate increases and debris crosses your arc each orbit
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: deep-space watercolor with ink-bleed thruster trails

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw signal paths across a monochrome e-ink motherboard before ghost traces overwrite your routes; circuits must close before the display refreshes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: closing one complete circuit board in under a minute
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: ghost traces appear faster and fewer free pads remain each level
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: e-ink monochrome with brief green phosphor bursts on connect

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort falling memory pages into keep or drop lanes before the OOM killer bar fills; heavy pages need two swipes, swap lanes shuffle mid-fall.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe left or right on falling blocks
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clearing the queue seconds before the red OOM bar maxes out
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: pages grow heavier, lanes swap positions, and purge warnings flash faster
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: terminal green on charcoal with CRT scanline flicker
